references.text: Aroer on the bank of the Arnon Valley is mentioned as the boundary of the area Israel conquered from Sihon, just as in Joshua 13:16.
Describes the same area from Aroer by the Arnon Valley that was given to the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
Aroer and the region near the Arnon are mentioned in connection with Israel's journey and conquest of the land east of the Jordan.
The sons of Gad built Aroer, which is the same city that marks the boundary in Joshua 13:16.
Describes the kingdom of Sihon as extending from Aroer on the bank of the Arnon Valley, with Medeba included in this area.
Medeba is mentioned as a city in Moab, highlighting its geographical and historical significance in the region.
Aroer is mentioned as a city where Israel lived for 300 years, confirming its importance as a border town.
